rfam.comment: Tetrahydrofolate (THF) riboswitch was first reported for Ames et al. [1] as an RNA motif in 5' untranslated (5'-UTR)regions of folate transport and biosynthesis genes in Firmicutes genomes. The structure of THF riboswitch has been reported in [2,3,4], it presents an inverted three-way junctional architecture. THF riboswitch presents a pseudoknot that joins P1-P2 and the loop of P3 and two THF binding. Tetrahydrofolate riboswitch structure is reported in PDB: 4LVV, 4LVW, 4LVX, 4LVY, 4LVZ, 4LW0 [4], 3SD3 [3], 3SUH, 3SUX, 3SUY [2], 6Q57 and 7KD1.
